jobs.title: NDT Technician
jobs.descriptionHtml: **NDT Technician** **Location:** Timika, Papua, Indonesia **Business Area:** Mining **Job Category:** Workshop **Employment Type:** Full-time **Job Purpose** The NDT Technician is responsible for performing Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) activities to ensure product quality, welding integrity, and compliance with engineering and safety standards. The role supports inspection, quality control, and documentation processes in workshop and site operations. **Key Responsibilities** * Perform Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) activities in accordance with applicable standards and procedures. * Conduct inspection and evaluation of welded joints and fabricated components. * Interpret technical and engineering drawings for inspection purposes. * Prepare inspection reports and maintain complete quality control documentation. * Ensure inspection activities comply with safety, quality, and operational requirements. * Coordinate with engineering, workshop, and production teams during inspection processes. Support continuous improvement related to quality and inspection practices. **Position Requirements** **Education** * Minimum **Diploma 3 (D3)** in **Mechanical Engineering** or related field. **Certification** * **Level II certification in Non-Destructive Testing (NDT)** – ASNT TC 1A * **Licensed Welding Inspector** (BNSP / B4T) **Experience** * Minimum **2–5 years** of experience in: + Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) operations at **Level II** + Welding inspection in industrial projects (construction or manufacturing) + Reading and interpreting technical & engineering drawings Preparing inspection reports and quality control documentation **Technical Skills** * NDT inspection and evaluation * Welding inspection * Technical drawing interpretation Quality documentation and reporting **Software Skills (Required)** * AutoCAD 2D & 3D * SolidWorks * Application Inventor Microsoft Office (Excel & Word, PPT) **Language Skills** * **Proficient in English** (spoken and written) **How to apply** Submit your application via our website www.sandvik.com/career Applications close: 08 November 2026 ***Only candidates who meet the qualifications will be processed***

jobs.title: Frontend Software Engineer - Global Payment - Jakarta
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Location :** Jakarta **Team :** Frontend **Employment Type :** Regular **Job Code :** A137843 Responsibilities About Global Payment Team Our Web and Client team in Global Payment is committed to building a highly integrated payment product that can be easily connected to the Web, App, cross-platform and other forms of Global Payment capabilities. In addition, we provide efficient and comprehensive services to developers, merchants and others through a series of platforms. Responsibilities - Build global consumer digital wallets and payment products to support global ecosystem business and users. As part of the international payment team, participate in system design, research and development, technological innovation, etc; - Build payment products for consumer users and cross platform products based on Web technology, including mobile and PC products; - Collaborate with product design, product management and software engineering teams to drive business success in efficiency and safety; - Keep at the forefront of emerging web-based technologies and trends, research and evaluate the latest web development frameworks, apply new technologies to drive iterative product improvements. Qualifications Minimum Qualification(s) - Experience in developing frontend web applications - Strong in JavaScript/HTML/CSS frontend experience, skilled in common web platforms such as React/Vue/Angular, and have good practice and understanding of common web compilation and bundling frameworks, including Webpack/Rollup/Babel/AST; - Have solid experience in implementing web applications with high performance, high availability, and excellent user experience; - Good problem solving skills and thinking patterns in web-based system design. Preferred Qualification(s) - Minimum 5 years relevant work experience from a large-scale internet business. - Experience in e-wallet and payment product development; - Agile, quick self learner, highly self-motivated with a strong sense of product ownership and creative problem solver; - Good collaborator and team player, comfortable working in a fast pace, diversified and global team environment. Job Information About Us Founded in 2012, ByteDance's mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. With a suite of more than a dozen products, including TikTok, Lemon8, CapCut and Pico as well as platforms specific to the China market, including Toutiao, Douyin, and Xigua, ByteDance has made it easier and more fun for people to connect with, consume, and create content. ​ Why Join ByteDance Inspiring creativity is at the core of ByteDance's mission. Our innovative products are built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and enrich life - a mission we work towards every day. ​ As ByteDancers, we strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our Company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us. ​ Diversity & Inclusion ​ ByteDance is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At ByteDance, our mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Category:** Engineering Product **Job Type:** Full Time **Job Location:** Bandung **Job Status:** Priority Hiring Bandung, Indonesia · Full-Time **About the Role** ------------------ We're looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer who is passionate about building impactful solutions that transform education. This role requires strong skills across both front-end and back-end, with the ability to design, build, and scale applications that are reliable, user-friendly, and aligned with our mission. You'll build end-to-end across our stack, working heavily with AI coding tools (especially Claude Code) — which means you'll direct that work, review it critically, and own the correctness and quality of what ships, front to back. We value adaptability, ownership, and a strong learning attitude. **Our stack:** Next.js + React (TypeScript, Tailwind) on the front end · Node.js/Express and Python/FastAPI on the back end · MongoDB + Redis · Git + CI/CD · GCP. These are deliberate, AI-friendly choices, so you can move fast and still review with confidence. **Before You Apply** -------------------- This role is not light, routine, or heavily guided. You'll handle ambiguity, move quickly across multiple priorities, and deliver production-ready solutions with little to no revision — including code an AI agent drafted and you made correct. You must stay calm under pressure, take full responsibility for your work, and deliver reliable outputs even when requirements shift mid-week or feedback needs a fast turnaround. If you want a role that will stretch your technical range, sharpen your problem-solving, and connect your work to a mission that matters, we'd love to hear from you. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Full-Stack Development** * Design and build front-end and back-end features for web and mobile: responsive, accessible interfaces in Next.js/React, and scalable APIs and services in Node.js/Express and Python/FastAPI. * Own features end-to-end — data model to UI — with sound design decisions and rigorous testing. * Work with MongoDB and Redis for reliable, performant data and state. **AI-Assisted Development & Oversight** * Direct Claude Code and other AI tools to build features fast, writing clear specs and prompts. * Review and refine AI-generated code across the stack; you're accountable for correctness, security, and maintainability — not the AI. * Set conventions and tests that keep AI output consistent and safe to ship. **Collaboration & Delivery** * Partner with product, design, and program teams to turn requirements into effective solutions. * Take part in agile ceremonies and code reviews, keep CI/CD deployments fast and safe, and provide prompt support for live systems. * Maintain clear technical documentation for the systems you build. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 3+ years as a full-stack developer shipping applications in production. * **Front end:** proficiency with Next.js/React and TypeScript (Tailwind or similar). * **Back end:** strong skills in Node.js/Express and/or Python/FastAPI; comfortable with Next.js server-side code. (Depth on one end plus solid range across the rest is fine — you don't need to be an expert in everything.) * Experience with MongoDB and Redis, and sound API design. * Disciplined testing, plus Git and CI/CD. * Ability to direct AI coding tools (especially **Claude Code**) and critically review their output — strong enough to catch what the AI gets wrong. * Strong problem-solving, attention to detail, accountability, and the ability to work independently under pressure. **Bonus Points If You Have** ---------------------------- * Containerized deployments (Docker or similar). * Experience with AI/ML or data-driven applications. * Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD beyond the basics. * A real knack for prompt and workflow design with agentic coding tools. * Experience in edtech, mission-driven, or non-profit projects. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- You'll be joining a team with a bold mission to transform education. We don't expect perfection, but we do expect creativity, ownership, and a strong learning attitude. If you're looking for routine work, this may not be the right fit. But if you're ready to build end-to-end solutions that matter and create real-world impact — we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Description** Job Description Our Tech & Product team members hail from the top company working experiences such as Facebook, Google, Amazon, Uber, Twitter, and Traveloka. Responsibilities: * You'll brainstorm with Product Managers, Designers, and Backend Engineers on your team to conceptualize and build new features for GudangAda large (and growing!) user base. * You’ll produce high-quality results by contributing heavily to team projects that have a significant impact on the business. * You’ll actively own team features or systems and define their long-term health, while also improving the health of surrounding systems. * You'll assist our skilled support team and operations team in triaging and resolving production issues. * You'll mentor other engineers and deeply review code. * You’ll improve engineering standards, tooling, and processes Tech stack that we use: * Reactjs * NextJS * Typescript * Redux: Library * TailwindCSS * Material UI: Design System **Qualifications** We are looking for someone with: * Deep passion for software engineering with an excellent understanding of software engineering concepts, design patterns, and algorithms. * You can contribute to technical architecture discussions and help drive technical decisions within your team. * You write understandable, testable code with an eye towards maintainability. * You are a strong communicator. jobs.title: Software Engineer (Backend) - E-Money [Go/Java]
jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer-2 Job Title Software Engineer (Backend) - E-Money [Go/Java] Job Description We are looking for Software Engineer (Backend). As a software engineer, you'll be the brain behind crafting, developing, testing, going live, and maintaining the system. You are passionate in understanding the business context for features built to drive better customer experience and adoption. **About E-Money** As part of Flip's Consumer Solutions group, you will be the go-to person to work on our e-money part, mainly the Flip Saldo feature. You will be working with a cross-functional team to answer various business questions e.g. increasing the number of transacting users with Flip Saldo. You will be utilizing different tech stacks for various use cases, such as Java (for E-Money core system), Go (cash top-up feature in one of the top Indonesian retailers), and PHP to a certain use case (integration with monolithic system). **About Flip** Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar, who were college friends in Universitas Indonesia, started Flip as a project in 2015 to transfer payments to each other at a fraction of what banks would charge them. They are pioneers in the Indonesian market, with their technology now helping millions of Indonesians, both individuals and businesses, carry out bank-to-bank money transfers through a reliable and seamless app. After nine years of operations, Flip has helped Indonesians transfer money worth several trillions of rupiah and has received double-digit funding from respectable investors such as Sequoia India, Insight Partner, and Insignia. Flip’s ultimate mission is to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world. At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. **What you'll do** * Work cross-functionally with the Product, Design, Operations, and Backend teams across the squads to ship world-class products and features. * Write code that's clear, concise, performant, tested, and easily understood by others. * Partner with the product management team to execute the feature roadmap. * Work with the overall backend teams to execute the engineering roadmap. * Help debug production issues across services and levels of the stack. **What you'll need** * Have a solid background in common programming problems and solutions. * Experience working with payment and/or accounting system is preferrable. * Knowledge and experience in Java and Go, PHP Yii2 experience is a plus. * Experience in working with large data set and/or high concurrency system is a plus. * Solid understanding of algorithms, algorithmic complexities, OOP, design patterns, and clean code. * Ability to plan, prioritize, estimate, and execute a task with a good degree of predictability. * Ability to scope, review and refine user stories and/or tasks for technical completeness and to alleviate dependency risk.

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer (Backend) - Core
jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer-1 Job Title Junior Software Engineer (Backend) - Core Job Description We’re hiring **Junior Software Engineers (Backend)** to join the **Core Payment Platform team** at Flip. If you’re passionate about building reliable systems, eager to learn, and excited to work on products that impact millions of Indonesians, this is your chance. **About Core Payment Platform** As part of the Payment Platform group, our team builds and maintains the critical services that power Flip’s ecosystem. We run over 20 projects that are essential for all business verticals, from money transfers to financial products. Our current mission is to break down Flip’s monolith service and set new engineering standards across the company. This is a rare opportunity to work on systems at scale, while learning modern backend practices in a supportive environment. We primarily use **Go** for our backend services, with **PostgreSQL** and **Redis** as our main data stores. Depending on the project, we use a mix of in-house tools and **Google Cloud Platform** services. **About Flip** Flip was founded in 2015 by three friends from Universitas Indonesia — Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar — with the goal of making money transfers fairer for Indonesians. Today, millions of individuals and businesses trust Flip to send trillions of rupiah across banks every year. We’re backed by leading investors such as **Sequoia India, Insight Partners, and Insignia**, and our mission is simple: **to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world.** At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. **What you’ll do** * Work with senior engineers to build and maintain backend services used across Flip’s ecosystem. * Write clear, tested, and efficient code, mainly in Go. * Review and learn from code written by peers and provide constructive feedback. * Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver reliable features. * Help troubleshoot and resolve production issues under guidance. **What you’ll need** * Basic programming experience in any backend language (Go experience is a strong plus). * Understanding of core computer science concepts: data structures, algorithms, OOP, and clean code principles. * Willingness to learn new tools and technologies quickly. * Good problem-solving mindset and eagerness to grow. * Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate in a team. * Alignment with Flip’s values of fairness, respect, and continuous learning. **Why join Flip?** * Learn directly from experienced engineers working on large-scale systems. * Be part of a mission-driven company making finance fairer in Indonesia. * Grow your career in a supportive and collaborative environment. * Enjoy fair rewards, clear goals, and recognition for your contributions.

jobs.title: Lead (Backend) Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About the GEO Team** ---------------------- GEO stands for Generative Engine Optimization. The GEO team builds products that help multi-location brands understand and improve how they are represented, cited, and recommended across AI-powered search and answer engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. We are building backend capabilities that collect and analyse signals from rapidly evolving AI platforms, measure brand visibility, and turn complex data into actionable recommendations for our customers. **About the Role** ------------------ As Backend Engineering Lead for Uberall’s GEO team, you will take on a **hybrid role that combines people management with hands-on engineering**. You will be responsible for the growth and effectiveness of the team, and you will also write code, review pull requests, and shape technical designs alongside them. On this team, leads stay close to the work. Hands-on contribution is a core part of the role, not something you step back from as the team grows. You will shape the architecture behind our AI-search products, lead the delivery of new capabilities, and help the team navigate a fast-moving and technically ambiguous domain. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders, you will translate customer needs and emerging developments in generative AI into reliable, scalable, and maintainable backend solutions. **Your Responsibilities** ------------------------- ### **People leadership** * Lead and develop the GEO backend team. This covers hiring, regular 1:1s, performance conversations, and supporting each engineer’s growth. * Own delivery with Product. Shape priorities, make sure commitments are realistic, and remove blockers so the team ships steadily. * Build the engineering culture of the team: shared standards, constructive code reviews, knowledge sharing, and collective ownership of quality. ### **Hands-on engineering** * Contribute regularly to design, code, and reviews as an active member of the team, not only as a reviewer or approver. * Guide the design and operation of backend systems that integrate with LLMs and AI-powered search platforms. * Establish robust approaches for evaluating the quality and consistency of AI-generated results. * Ensure that LLM-enabled capabilities are observable, testable, cost-efficient, and resilient to changing models and external providers. * Help the team manage the particular challenges of generative AI systems, including non-deterministic behaviour, latency, rate limits, data quality, and graceful degradation. * Stay informed about relevant developments in LLMs and AI search, assessing them pragmatically rather than adopting technology for its own sake. **Your Profile** ---------------- ### **Must have** * Proven experience leading an engineering team with genuine people responsibility (hiring, 1:1s, performance, and delivery) while continuing to contribute code and technical design. * Motivation to stay hands-on as a lead, balancing management responsibilities with regular engineering work. * Strong proficiency in Kotlin or Groovy; proven coding skills in other JVM languages (such as Java or Scala) are a plus. * Solid experience with our core stack and architecture: Spring Boot, Hibernate, JUnit, MySQL, Elasticsearch, Docker, AWS and OpenAPI, applied within microservice and event-driven systems. * Hands-on experience building or operating production systems that use LLMs, generative AI, or AI-powered external services. * An understanding of how to evaluate and monitor LLM-enabled features beyond traditional deterministic testing. * Experience designing reliable integrations with third-party APIs and managing concerns such as cost, latency, rate limits, observability, and provider failure. * The ability to distinguish between an effective AI use case and one better solved with conventional software. ### **Nice to have** * Experience with Python and LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph. * Experience with prompt management, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, or LLM evaluation frameworks. No experience training foundation models is required; this is a backend engineering and engineering leadership role.

proven coding skills in other JVM languages (such as Java or Scala) are a plus. * Solid experience with our core stack and architecture: Spring Boot, Hibernate, JUnit, MySQL, Elasticsearch, Docker, AWS and OpenAPI, applied within microservice and event-driven systems. * Hands-on experience building or operating production systems that use LLMs, generative AI, or AI-powered external services. * An understanding of how to evaluate and monitor LLM-enabled features beyond traditional deterministic testing. * Experience designing reliable integrations with third-party APIs and managing concerns such as cost, latency, rate limits, observability, and provider failure. * The ability to distinguish between an effective AI use case and one better solved with conventional software. ### **Nice to have** * Experience with Python and LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph. * Experience with prompt management, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, or LLM evaluation frameworks. No experience training foundation models is required; this is a backend engineering and engineering leadership role.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology startup helping freight forwarders turn data into better decisions and measurable business impact. Portcast uses AI to surface shipment exceptions, cost risks, and the right actions, helping teams focus on the shipments that need their attention, keep freight costs under control, and make procurement decisions with confidence. Our vision is to be the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment. Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are building for an industry at a critical inflection point of digital transformation. Our team of software engineers, data scientists, and logistics experts is on a mission to build the technology that helps freight forwarders protect margin, improve operational efficiency, and differentiate their offering. ### **ABOUT THE ROLE:** As our Backend Engineer, you will be reporting directly to our Engineering Manager and will work closely with our Product team to develop new products, scale existing ones and manage deployments and architecture. You won't just take tickets here. You'll dig into how the system actually works, ask why before how, and chase a problem past the surface to the real cause. Curiosity isn't a nice-to-have on this team, it's how we build. ### **WHAT YOU’LL OWN:** * Design, build and maintain APIs, services and systems and debug production issues across multiple levels of the stack. * Collaborate closely with our Business, Product and Data Science teams to understand and solve customer pain points at scale. * Design, Develop, Implement and Deploy enterprise level, high availability web application platforms, with support from the design team at Portcast. * Create a technology infrastructure that functions well at scale. You will design and improve the system architecture. * Own end-to-end the design AND implementation of how our product handles real-time data at scale, from event ingestion across dozens of carrier sources, through data normalization, through ML-powered risk and ETA models, to the user-visible recommendations our enterprise customers act on. * Build features customers actually use, harden internal tooling the team relies on, and create the alerting and monitoring surfaces that catch issues before customers do. You're a builder first, with the judgment to know what's worth building. * Make architecture trade-offs explicit and defensible. * Instrument what you build, find real bottlenecks, and pick fixes that survive the next 10× of growth, not just the next sprint. You measure before you optimize, and your numbers are reproducible. ### **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:** * Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or equivalent work experience in the field. * Work Experience: Minimum 5+ years of experience in a technical role designing, developing and releasing technical solutions and building production systems. * Curious by Default: You dig deeper instead of following instructions to the letter. When something in the system surprises you, you chase the why, not just the fix. You treat every layer of the stack as something worth understanding, and you ask the good questions early. * System Architecture: You understand how parts of a system fit together and have a strong background in building scalable products or systems. You are comfortable in dealing with lots of moving pieces/data sources and possess meticulous attention to detail. You are quick to generate ideas and give suggestions on how to improve the tech stack and feature developments. * First Principles Thinker: When you explain a past decision, the trade-offs come out before the tools. You name the constraint, the alternatives you considered, and why you picked what you picked. You don't reach for a new framework when a tighter use of an existing tool would do the job. * You use AI tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude, etc.) where they make you faster, and you know exactly where they fall short. You read what they produce, you don't just paste it. You can defend a code path the AI suggested, or override it with reasoning the AI couldn't have known. You flag AI-assisted decisions in code review and submissions without being asked. We treat AI as a tool that makes good thinking faster, not a shortcut around thinking. * Team Player: You have experience working in a diverse, dynamic and cross-cultural team. This role is an opportunity to drive engineering excellence within the team and participate in key architectural discussions. You are a hands-on goal-orientated engineer who works according to milestones and software guidelines, following agile principles. * Empathetic Communicator: You can communicate nuanced ideas clearly, from real-time remote brainstorming to explaining a technical decision in writing. You may be opinionated, but in disagreements you engage thoughtfully with other perspectives and can compromise when needed. * You've either been an early engineering hire at a startup where you took a technical product from scratch to scale, OR you've owned real system design at a FAANG-tier engineering org, defended architectural decisions in actual design reviews, not just contributed to someone else's blueprint. Either path counts! We'd love to hear the learnings and the trade-offs you'd make differently today. * Tech Stack: Ideally you are proficient with Python-based backend programming, web frameworks like Flask, Amazon Web Services. You are able to design RESTful APIs and are aware of best practices. Experience with Docker, Git, Elasticsearch, Spark, CI/CD is a plus. The specific stack matters less than how you reason about it. Strong engineers in any stack pick ours up quickly. ### **WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:** * Globally distributed, remote-first flexibility: Work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration. Our diversity of perspectives fuels innovation and keeps us curious. * Tech-first team: You’ll work with like-minded individuals who share a passion for solving difficult problems using technology. * Accelerated growth: Compress the learning curve in a couple of years by owning the web app from day one as your own baby. We are building our company to be the next B2B market leader in predictive global supply chains and you’ll be a major part of our story. * Impact you can see: With a lean structure, your work is effective from the start. You’ll see the results of your ideas and decisions directly moving the business forward. ### **Our CORE Values Guide Everything We Do:** * Curiosity: We read the code before we trust it. We dig into why a system behaves the way it does, not just how to make the error go away. * Ownership: We act like founders. We don't wait for a ticket to fix what's broken, and we stay on a problem until it's actually solved in production. * Raising the bar: We do not settle for code that only works locally or solves the immediate request. We aim for backend systems that are reliable, scalable, maintainable, and easy for the team to reason about. * Effectiveness: We focus on engineering work that creates real product and customer impact. We prioritize the right problems, make practical trade-offs, and ship solutions that improve outcomes, not just output. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: TikTok Shop by Tokopedia - SMB Mass Incubation Manager - Indonesia
jobs.descriptionHtml: Commerce ops TikTok Shop by Tokopedia - SMB Mass Incubation Manager - Indonesia **Location :** Jakarta **Employment Type :** Regular **Job Code :** A36585 Responsibilities Drive scalable, cost-efficient acquisition and activation of high-quality sellers by identifying growth opportunities, designing onboarding strategies, and partnering with product, operations, and commercial teams to improve seller self-serve experiences. The role is accountable for converting newly acquired sellers into GMV-generating contributors through data-driven interventions, process optimization, and product feature enhancements. - Define and execute the Targeted incubation strategy across Fashion, FMCG, Lifestyle 1, Lifestyle 2 and Auto-EL clusters on TTS and Toko: quarterly DAGMV target-setting, cluster-level breakdown, and basic-seller unlock roadmap. - Own Basic Seller performance across TTS ROI2 / GMV Max, Mega Campaign participation, Basic Product Adoption, Content Basic and ShopTab Basic; design force-registration, opt-in affiliate and Robocall interventions. - Manage BPO Operations for the entire Targeted book: management ratio, seller-movement governance (keep sellers with same AM), IH POC continuity, agent hiring & ramp, and monthly capacity plans. - Drive Responsiveness KPIs: seller response rate, first-response-time < 30 min, 2-way weekly communication frequency, WhatsApp / phone bind rates and OCIC data quality. - Own Agent Effectiveness & NPS: partner with QAT on scenario-based SOPs, dynamic issue-escalation playbook, centralised policy channel, and category-specific training for GNE, Ads and Campaign topics. - Own the Robocall / AI-host outreach program: use-case selection (unresponsive sellers, product-supply push, campaign registration), script iteration, consent flow and connected-rate tracking; partner with the Robocall product owner on setup and QA. - Own the Seller Mission operating model: mission portfolio design (opt-in affiliate, deal hunting, campaign participation, GMV growth missions), targeting, injection cadence and impact measurement. - Drive platform fundamentals — available products, Product Show PV, Product Click PV — through supply push with responsive sellers and Robocall for the rest of the pool. - Design cluster-and-AOV-based platform vouchers with Growth / Category / Campaign teams to lift basket size and efficient GMV growth. - Run the Q1/Q2 review cadence (highlight, lowlight, next-quarter plan) and cross-functional working groups with Ads, Campaign, Growth, Mission and Product PMs; convert seller-visit and NPS insights into concrete platform / policy asks. - Report monthly on cluster DAGMV, basic-seller adoption, responsiveness, agent NPS, Robocall connected-rate and mission adoption to ID SMB leadership. Qualifications Minimum Qualification(s) - 5+ years of experience in e-Commerce operations, seller / account management, category management, growth or product-operations roles at a marketplace, platform or high-growth internet business; at least 2 years leading a book of managed sellers on a marketplace. - Proven ability to manage a scalable process — designing ratios, playbooks, monitoring dashboards, and tech-enabled operations (mission platforms, self-serve growth loops, AI-outreach / robocall) — to hit GMV, adoption and NPS targets simultaneously. - Hands-on experience managing a BPO / vendor workforce: SLA design, ramp plans, quality QA, incentive schemes and multi-vendor comparison. - Analytical and structured problem-solver, comfortable pulling cohort / cluster / channel / campaign views and translating them into weekly operational moves. - Excellent cross-team collaboration with Product, Ads, Campaign, Growth, Mission and Central Ops; fluent in English and Bahasa Indonesia to work with Indonesia sellers, BPO agents and regional cross-functional partners. Preferred Qualification(s) - Prior experience in Fashion, FMCG, Beauty, Baby, Lifestyle, Home & Living, Automotive, 3C / Electronics or other high-frequency or high-AOV categories in Indonesia or SEA e-commerce. - Familiarity with AI-driven customer-outreach systems (robocall, chatbot, mission platforms) and with running A/B tests on outreach content, cadence and consent flows. - Structured and original thinker, strong data sense, analytical skills and judgment capability — comfortable operating with incomplete dashboards and moving forward on best available evidence. - Quick learner, proactive and resilient; able to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous, multi-platform (TTS + Tokopedia) environment. Job Information About TikTok TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo. ​ Why Join Us Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day. ​ We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us. ​ ​ Diversity & Inclusion ​ TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

jobs.title: Regional Service Sales Manager-East
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Requirements** Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably. At **Siemens Healthineers (SHS)**, our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions. Apply now for the **Regional Service Sales Manager-East** position and play a key role in the **Indonesia** team. Based in **Makassar**, this role is responsible for driving service sales and managing the service portfolio across **Eastern Indonesia**. The position will work closely with the product sales team, support key customers, identify business opportunities, and deliver service solutions that address customer needs. **Key Responsibilities** * Drive sales and manage the service product portfolio across Eastern Indonesia. * Support the product sales team in positioning and selling service solutions. * Launch local service campaigns in line with regional and global requirements. * Analyze key account needs, business conditions, and portfolio opportunities. * Develop tailored service offerings and master agreements in collaboration with customers and the Service Business Support Head. * Build and maintain strong relationships with assigned customers, providing end-to-end support. * Identify, track, and follow up on post-warranty service opportunities and proposals. * Maintain an accurate pipeline and business forecast for customer service sales opportunities. * Conduct win-loss analyses for completed service proposals. * Understand customer requirements and recommend appropriate service solutions. * Support market research and business analysis for Customer Service management. * Provide service sales support at the point of sale. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, Management, Engineering, or a related field. * 3–5 years of relevant experience, preferably in the medical technology, healthcare, or service industry. * Experience in service sales, account management, marketing, or business development. * Strong communication, presentation, and organizational skills. * Good project management and cross-functional collaboration capabilities. * Commercial awareness and an understanding of customer and market needs. * Proficiency in spoken and written English. * Knowledge of relevant regional languages is an advantage. * Willingness to be based in Makassar and support customers across Eastern Indonesia. **Skills and Competencies** * **Customer focus:** Understands customer needs, identifies service issues, and follows through to ensure customer satisfaction. * **Sales planning and development:** Identifies opportunities, manages the sales pipeline, and develops customer-focused proposals. * **Market analysis:** Applies appropriate market research methods to assess customer needs, competitors, and business opportunities. * **Market knowledge:** Understands key market players, competing offerings, industry developments, and market challenges. * **Presentation skills:** Delivers clear, structured, and audience-appropriate presentations, both in person and virtually. * **Teamwork and collaboration:** Shares information, seeks input, respects different perspectives, and fulfills commitments. * **Product and technical knowledge:** Understands the relevant product, system, and solution portfolio and can use technical and commercial documentation effectively. * **Results orientation:** Takes ownership of outcomes, maintains high standards, and works proactively to overcome obstacles. To find out more about the specific business, have a look at https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/en-id **Who we are:** We are a team of more than 73,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways. **How we work:** When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably. **To all recruitment agencies:** Siemens Healthineers' recruitment is internally managed, with external support permitted only when a qualified supplier has established a formal contract with us. Unsolicited candidate submissions and referrals, absent a current supplier contract, do not establish consent and are ineligible for fees. We delete and destroy unsolicited information, thus, would recommend you refrain from any such practices. Your adherence to our policies is appreciated.

jobs.title: Head of Partnerships, APAC (all genders)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Distribusion** is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com. We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by three leading VCs (Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), we are ready to push beyond following our recent €30 m Series B. **The Opportunity** We are searching for a **Head of Partnerships, APAC** to lead our client delivery and technical partnership strategy across Asia-Pacific. In this leadership role, you and your growing team of on-the-ground Technical Partnerships Managers will act as the owners of all key technical partnerships, projects and initiatives in the region. You will play a central role in delivering complex direct operator tooling, while informing central roadmaps, and building scalable delivery blueprints to accelerate our growth across Asia-Pacific. **What you will do:** * **Lead Key Project Delivery:** Act as the lead Project Manager and key counterpart for high-profile key accounts in APAC, taking full ownership from pre-sales, tenders, and initial requirements gathering through to deployment, rollout, and hypercare. * **Manage & Scale Technical Partnerships:** Lead and grow our APAC Technical Partnerships team, who oversee API, IMS, and White Label product implementations, while account managing tier A partnerships. * **Processualise & Build Blueprints:** While delivering complex projects simultaneously creating standard delivery blueprints, PM frameworks, and structured documentation to increase operational efficiency in the region. * **Inform Roadmap of IMS, White Label, and the API for the Region:** Drive product and technical requirements gathering and definition for the APAC region through your client projects. * **Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration:** Serve as the bridge from the region to our central product teams and align with Partnerships functions from other regions and specialisations. **Workplace:** We are mainly looking for this role to be based in Vietnam or Indonesia. We are a remote-first company, with teams located around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office. **Who you are:** * **Experience:** Proven experience in project management, product delivery, or technical partnerships within travel tech, SaaS, fintech, or mobility sectors. * **Technical & Product Savvy:** Deep understanding of B2B platforms, API integrations, and white-label solutions. * **Execution & Ownership:** Thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments with a strong bias for action, capable of managing high-stakes client relationships while building delivery frameworks from scratch. * **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Strong ability to conduct requirement gap analyses, evaluate talent, and collaborate seamlessly with Product, Tech, Sales, and Leadership teams. * **Languages:** Business fluent in English. * **Travel:** Willingness to travel (approx. 1x per month) across Asia-Pacific for key client visits, team alignment, and on-site project rollouts. **What you can expect:** * You will join a fast-paced travel tech company and take on a rapidly growing industry * You will take on ownership and responsibility from day one and have a direct impact on the success of the company * We value agility! We’re constantly updating our tech stack and offer the best possible tools to ensure all of our in-house engineers, partners, and carriers benefit from cutting-edge, efficient solutions * You will work with global companies. Our product attracts the biggest names in travel technology, such as Booking.com, Google Maps, and national carriers like Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF. * You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day! * We offer flexible and remote working conditions, relocation opportunities, and career growth in a small and developing company. **Our hiring process for this role:** Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Anh Do and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Alexander Sheldon. We are a remote-first company, with teams located around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office. **Who you are:** * **Experience:** Proven experience in project management, product delivery, or technical partnerships within travel tech, SaaS, fintech, or mobility sectors. * **Technical & Product Savvy:** Deep understanding of B2B platforms, API integrations, and white-label solutions. * **Execution & Ownership:** Thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments with a strong bias for action, capable of managing high-stakes client relationships while building delivery frameworks from scratch. * **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Strong ability to conduct requirement gap analyses, evaluate talent, and collaborate seamlessly with Product, Tech, Sales, and Leadership teams. * **Languages:** Business fluent in English. * **Travel:** Willingness to travel (approx. 1x per month) across Asia-Pacific for key client visits, team alignment, and on-site project rollouts. **What you can expect:** * You will join a fast-paced travel tech company and take on a rapidly growing industry * You will take on ownership and responsibility from day one and have a direct impact on the success of the company * We value agility! jobs.descriptionHtml: Kenvue is currently recruiting for a: Maintenance Technician **What we do** At Kenvue, we realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. Built on over a century of heritage and rooted in science, we’re the house of iconic brands - including NEUTROGENA®, AVEENO®, TYLENOL®, LISTERINE®, JOHNSON’S® and BAND-AID® that you already know and love. Science is our passion; care is our talent. **Who We Are** Our global team is ~ 22,000 brilliant people with a workplace culture where every voice matters, and every contribution is appreciated. We are passionate about insights, innovation and committed to delivering the best products to our customers. With expertise and empathy, being a Kenvuer means having the power to impact millions of people every day. We put people first, care fiercely, earn trust with science and solve with courage – and have brilliant opportunities waiting for you! Join us in shaping our future–and yours. **Role reports to:** Senior Engineering Manager **Location:** Asia Pacific, Indonesia, Jawa, Jakarta Raya **Work Location:** Fully Onsite **What you will do** **Kenvue is currently recruiting for:** **Maintenance Technician** **This position reports into Senior Engineering Manager and is based in Jakarta.** **What You Will Do** The Maintenance Technician is responsible for performing preventive and corrective maintenance on production line equipment, packaging machines, process machines, and plant utility systems to ensure optimal plant operations, equipment reliability, and minimal downtime. This role supports smooth production activities by troubleshooting mechanical and electrical breakdowns, conducting root cause analysis, and ensuring all maintenance activities are performed safely and efficiently. **Key Responsibilities** * Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on **production line, packaging machines, and process equipment**. * Troubleshoot and repair mechanical and electrical breakdowns on **production, packaging, and process machines**. * Maintain and troubleshoot **plant utility systems**, including air compressors, boilers, chillers, HVAC systems supporting production, water systems, and related utility equipment. * Conduct root cause analysis on equipment failures and implement corrective and preventive actions. * Support production teams during machine breakdowns to minimize downtime and ensure operational continuity. * Develop and execute preventive maintenance plans to improve equipment reliability and efficiency. * Utilize computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS) for work order management, preventive maintenance tracking, and documentation. * Maintain accurate maintenance logs, inspection records, and spare part requisitions. * Ensure compliance with safety procedures, safe work practices, and proper use of tools and personal protective equipment. * Support continuous improvement initiatives related to equipment performance and plant reliability. **Required Qualifications** * 2–4 years of experience in maintenance within a **manufacturing or production environment**. * Hands-on experience maintaining and troubleshooting **packaging machines and/or process machines**. * Experience handling **plant utility systems in a manufacturing setting**. * Strong troubleshooting skills in both mechanical and electrical systems. * Experience using computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS). * Ability to read and interpret mechanical and electrical drawings. * Understanding of production process flow and machine integration. * Experience handling breakdown situations and minimizing production downtime. **Desired Qualifications** * Experience in FMCG or manufacturing industry. * Basic knowledge of PLC troubleshooting. * Experience in root cause analysis and continuous improvement initiatives. * Good communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with production teams. * Ability to work in a fast-paced production environment and adapt to changing priorities. **What’s In It For You** * Competitive Benefit Package * Paid Company Holidays, Paid Vacation, Volunteer Time, Summer Fridays & More! * Learning & Development Opportunities * Employee Resource Groups Kenvue is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identify, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. If you are an individual with a disability, please check our Disability Assistance page for information on how to request an accommodation.

Desired Qualifications * Experience in maintenance of utilities and plant facilities. * Exposure to digital tools and systems (e.g., CMMS, IoT monitoring systems). * Track record of initiating or leading improvement projects. * Experience working with global teams or in a matrix organization. * Ability to coach and mentor technicians effectively. **What’s In It For You** * Competitive Benefit Package * Learning & Development Opportunities * undefinedKenvue is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Senior Influencer Marketing Manager (Performance)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About us** ============ Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/ **About the role** ================== We are looking for a Senior Influencer Marketing Manager to build influencer marketing as a new performance channel for one of our core D2C subscription products — a product that has already acquired over 100 million users through paid ads on every major network. Influencers are a new channel for us: you will own it end to end — from the first plan to a scaled channel across Europe, Latin America and Asia. You will report to the Head of User Acquisition. This is a performance role, not brand awareness. Every collaboration is measured by paid subscriptions, CPA and ROI. Data and tracking are already in place, and a hands-on UA team will support you. We give large budgets and expect a highly experienced person in return: someone who thrives in a very fast-paced environment and takes full accountability for the channel's data and metrics. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== ### **Build the Channel** * Build influencer marketing from zero: markets, platforms, creator tiers, deal models and budget, in a written plan. * Launch first campaigns within your first month, then scale the ones that pay back. * Prioritise markets by results: start where the cost per subscription is lowest, then expand. ### **Creators & Deals** * Find and qualify creators on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube in Europe, Latin America and Asia. * Build a network of creators, agencies and creator networks in each region. * Negotiate deals: flat fee, CPA, hybrid. Keep the cost of every deal tied to its result. * Manage the full cycle: outreach, contract, brief, content approval, publication, payment. ### **Tracking & Results** * Set up tracking for every creator: unique links, attribution. * Be fully accountable for the channel's data and metrics: spend, subscriptions, CPA and ROI per creator. Keep the numbers accurate and report weekly with a clear decision — rebook, scale or stop. * Keep a database of creators, prices, results and learnings. **Qualifications** ================== * 3+ years in influencer marketing with a performance focus — for D2C subscription apps, mobile apps or online products. * Managed influencer budgets of $50K+ per month with measurable results: spend, number of creators, CPA or ROI (examples required). * Hands-on experience in at least one of our regions: Europe, Latin America or Asia. * Experience sourcing and negotiating with creators directly, not only through agencies. * Experience with CPA and hybrid deals. * Experience setting up tracking: links, attribution. * Knowledge of TikTok, Instagram and YouTube rules for sponsored content. * Fluent written & spoken English. **Nice to have** ================ * Built an influencer channel from zero. * Experience with influencer platforms and tools (Modash, CreatorIQ, Upfluence or similar). * Experience with health, education or self-improvement products. **Working Attributes** ====================== * Results over reach — measures every deal by subscriptions, not views. * Owns the numbers — knows the CPA and ROI of every creator without asking an analyst. * Hands-on — does outreach and negotiation personally. * Thrives in a fast-paced environment — launches, measures and decides in days, not months. * Organised — tracks every creator, deal and payment. * Reliable — delivers what was promised, when it was promised. **Location** ============ Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours. **Benefits** ============ * Build a new channel from zero, with large budgets and full ownership * Product with 100M+ users and proven ads to learn from * Remote work environment (work from anywhere) * Competitive compensation — details shared during interview * Performance bonus tied to channel results, on top of salary * Company-provided equipment (if needed) Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth! **Interview Process** ===================== After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps: * Recruiter Screening (40 minutes) * Technical Interview (60 minutes) * Final Interview (60 minutes) **Life at Ruby Labs** ===================== At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day. This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen. Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success. #LI-Remote

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml: Job Posting Date2026.10.29 Job TypeRegular TeamProduct Management Location BSD City, Indonesia About TravelokaTraveloka is Southeast Asia’s leading all-in-one travel platform connecting millions globally with trusted, world-class experiences. With over 140 million app downloads and more than 40 million monthly active users, Traveloka stands as one of the most popular travel apps in the region. **Job Description** =================== *Job ID: MJ000427* We seek a talented and experienced Senior Product Manager with strong expertise in customer-facing mobile Apps and Desktop web platforms to join our dynamic team. Our Product Management team plays a vital role in transforming ideas into innovative products that address user experience needs and elevate the Traveloka experience. You will also be driving the development and implementation of critical technical products that enhance our platform's capabilities and help users discover and fulfill their travel inspiration and needs. * Contribute to the technical product vision and strategy across customer-facing Apps and Desktop product lines within Demand Products. * Develops and maintains detailed product roadmaps, incorporating technical input and aligning with business priorities, focusing on specific phases like ideation or post-launch optimization. * Guides and mentors junior team members, fostering technical literacy and collaboration with engineering teams. * Collaborate with engineering teams to define technical requirements, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance of customer-facing platforms across Apps and Desktop. * Conduct in-depth market research and competitive analysis on customer-facing app and web experiences, industry UX trends, and digital product benchmarks to identify opportunities for innovation. * Design, run, and analyze A/B tests and other experiments to validate product hypotheses and drive iterative improvements across Apps and Desktop. * Work with UX/UI designers and data scientists to support cohesive product strategies across platforms. * Help prioritize features and manage backlog with oversight from senior managers. * Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) for product performance and identify areas for technical improvement. * Stay informed on industry trends and emerging technologies relevant to the product line. Requirements: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field from a reputable university. * Minimum 8 years of product management experience, with at least 3 years managing customer-facing mobile Apps and/or Desktop web products. * Experience in travel, e-commerce, or other high-traffic consumer app environments. * Proven experience handling customer-facing Apps and Desktop platforms, with strong understanding of cross-platform user experience, app performance, and API-driven product development. * Experience designing and running A/B tests or other experimentation methods to inform product decisions. * Strong understanding of software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum). * Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to think strategically. * Proven track record of successful product launches and iterations. * Strong analytical skills with experience in data-driven decision-making. * Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to bridge the gap between business needs and technical implementation.

jobs.title: UI/UX Designer (26-07001)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Jadi bagian dari tim hebat dari perusahaan global.** ------------------------------------------------------ Bergabunglah dengan perusahaan global kami dan buka peluang tanpa batas dengan berkolaborasi bersama tim yang beragam dan berbakat. Bersama-sama, kami menciptakan kesuksesan, mendorong inovasi, dan menciptakan dunia dengan berbagai peluang yang tak terbatas. ### **Detail Pekerjaan** * Conduct research about website and app UI and UX based on target audience, needs, and behaviors. * Create wireframes (basic sketches) to outline the structure and layout of the website or app. * Develop interactive UI/UX prototypes to demonstrate how the product will function. * Design the look and feel of the product, including color schemes, typography, and iconography. * Ensure the design aligns with the brand identity and is visually appealing. * Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to bring designs to life. * Create and maintain design systems or style guides to ensure consistency across the product. * Document design standards and best practices. ### **Persyaratan Keahlian** * Have minimum 3 years' experience as UI/UX Designer. * Must have experience with design tools like Adobe XD, Figma etc. * Must have experience in mobile and web design. * Understand design practical and user centered digital experience using modern design tools methodologies. * Can collaborate with team to improve UI/UX based expected output result. * Strong understanding of design principles, including layout, color theory, and typography. * Strong eye for detail in creating pixel-perfect designs. ### **Tingkat Pendidikan** * Bachelor Degree of Graphic Design, Interaction Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field. * Diploma 3 Diploma from any discipline.

jobs.title: UI/UX Design (Full-Time)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Description:** * Merancang user interface (UI) dan user experience (UX) untuk website, aplikasi, dan platform digital perusahaan. * Melakukan riset pengguna untuk memahami kebutuhan, perilaku, dan permasalahan pengguna. * Membuat user flow, wireframe, mockup, dan prototype sebagai acuan pengembangan produk digital. * Mengembangkan desain yang intuitif, menarik, responsif, dan mudah digunakan. * Melakukan usability testing serta mengevaluasi desain berdasarkan feedback pengguna. * Berkolaborasi dengan tim Product Manager, Developer, dan tim terkait untuk memastikan desain dapat diimplementasikan sesuai kebutuhan. * Mengembangkan dan memelihara design system serta menjaga konsistensi visual pada produk digital. * Melakukan evaluasi dan perbaikan desain secara berkala berdasarkan hasil pengujian dan kebutuhan bisnis. * Memastikan desain sesuai dengan prinsip usability, accessibility, dan responsive design. * Mengikuti perkembangan tren desain UI/UX serta menerapkan praktik terbaik dalam pengembangan produk digital. **Qualifications:** * Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 di bidang Desain Komunikasi Visual, Desain Grafis, Sistem Informasi, atau bidang terkait. * Memiliki pengalaman sebagai UI/UX Designer menjadi nilai tambah. * Menguasai Figma atau tools desain sejenis. * Memahami prinsip UI/UX design, user-centered design, wireframing, prototyping, dan usability testing. * Memiliki kemampuan menyusun user flow, wireframe, mockup, dan prototype interaktif. * Memahami responsive design serta prinsip dasar accessibility. * Memiliki portofolio desain UI/UX yang menunjukkan proses dan hasil perancangan. * Memiliki kemampuan berpikir analitis, kreatif, dan berorientasi pada kebutuhan pengguna. * Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun berkolaborasi dalam tim. * Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan manajemen waktu yang baik. jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Product Designer** ==================== Product On-site Jakarta, Indonesia **We’re Building the Future of Capital Markets;** ------------------------------------------------- ‍ enabling entrepreneurship, job creation, financial inclusion, and economic resilience*‍* *As Asia's largest licensed digital securities exchange for alternative investments, Alta is at the forefront of building critical capital market infrastructure. We believe that access to capital markets are pivotal in all economies, we recognize that our role in building this critical infrastructure goes beyond facilitating trades; it paves the way for entrepreneurship, job creation, financial inclusion, and economic resilience, fostering a brighter future for emerging markets and economies.* **Empowering Private Markets**: Through our Digital Exchange, we enable the tokenization and digital custody of alternative assets. This end-to-end solution simplifies and expedites the trading of smaller asset blocks, ultimately facilitating access and liquidity in private markets. **Innovative Financial Ecosystem**: Our journey has seen us transition from securities trading and distribution of comprehensive products, including equities, private credit, funds, and asset-backed securities (“ABS”) (representing Real World Assets ("RWA") like whiskies, wines, art, watches, and real estate) to include fund management and digital custody services. As the only integrated securities exchange, brokerage, and fund management group with the necessary regulatory licenses and a proven track record in Southeast Asia, we are actively exploring new channels and partnerships to extend our impact to entrepreneurs and investors globally. Established in 2016 and headquartered in Singapore, Alta operates offices globally. We welcome energetic and creative individuals to be part of this ambitious journey with us. ‍ **About The Role** ------------------ We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our small, hands-on design team and help shape the platforms that power Alta’s marketplace for alternative investments. You’ll design features and flows across our core and client product suites, turning complex financial workflows and data into experiences that feel clear and intuitive for investors, issuers and internal teams. Working closely with a senior designer, product managers and engineers, you’ll be involved in the full design process, from understanding the problem and supporting user research to prototyping, handoff and iteration after launch. This is a great fit for someone with a few years of product design experience who wants real ownership of their work, room to grow their craft, and the chance to learn a fast-moving corner of fintech along the way. ‍ **What you'll do** ------------------ * Own features and flows end-to-end, from problem framing and research support through wireframes, prototypes, handoff and post-launch iteration, with guidance from a senior designer * Turn complex workflows and financial data into clear, usable screens in Figma * Use and contribute/iterate to our existing design system so products stay consistent * Partner with PMs, engineers and QA to understand requirements and make sure designs ship as intended * Maintain regular updates and communications with team members, ensure alignment on design decisions, and refine based on feedback with cross functional teams. #### **In your first 6 months, you might** * Ship features end to end, keep the experience consistent across products, and shape the design system * Learn to work with our design libraries and system: create new components and patterns and help maintain and refine the existing ones * Turn product requirements into flows and mockups, and run design sessions with PMs and engineers * Stay involved throughout feature development and testing, balancing quality with speed. ‍ **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Around 2–3 years of product design (UI/UX) experience, in-house, agency or freelance * A strong portfolio with at least 2 case studies that show your process and what you learned, not just final screens * At least one shipped product or feature you can talk discuss in detail * Comfortable in Figma, with a working understanding of how software gets built * Confident communicating in English, written and spoken, including explaining design decisions to non-designers * Curious and open to feedback, with a genuine interest in growing your craft alongside a senior designer. * Balances outcomes for both users and the business #### **Preferred (Nice to have)** * Experience with Jira, Confluence or product analytics tools * Ability to leverage AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Figma AI) in your design workflow * A solid understanding of the SDLC and how a product is delivered as end-to-end working software * Prior experience in fintech, finance, or investment platforms is a plus ‍ If you are interested please send your resume to jobs@alta.exchange. Only successful applicants will be contacted.

jobs.descriptionHtml: **We’re Building the Future of Capital Markets;** ------------------------------------------------- **‍**enabling entrepreneurship, job creation, financial inclusion, and economic resilience*‍* *As Asia's largest licensed digital securities exchange for alternative investments, Alta is at the forefront of building critical capital market infrastructure. We believe that access to capital markets are pivotal in all economies, we recognize that our role in building this critical infrastructure goes beyond facilitating trades; it paves the way for entrepreneurship, job creation, financial inclusion, and economic resilience, fostering a brighter future for emerging markets and economies.* **Empowering Private Markets**: Through our Digital Exchange, we enable the tokenization and digital custody of alternative assets. This end-to-end solution simplifies and expedites the trading of smaller asset blocks, ultimately facilitating access and liquidity in private markets. **Innovative Financial Ecosystem**: Our journey has seen us transition from securities trading and distribution of comprehensive products, including equities, private credit, funds, and asset-backed securities (“ABS”) (representing Real World Assets ("RWA") like whiskies, wines, art, watches, and real estate) to include fund management and digital custody services. As the only integrated securities exchange, brokerage, and fund management group with the necessary regulatory licenses and a proven track record in Southeast Asia, we are actively exploring new channels and partnerships to extend our impact to entrepreneurs and investors globally. Established in 2016 and headquartered in Singapore, Alta operates offices globally. We welcome energetic and creative individuals to be part of this ambitious journey with us. ‍ **About The Role** ------------------ We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our small, hands-on design team and help shape the platforms that power Alta’s marketplace for alternative investments. You’ll design features and flows across our core and client product suites, turning complex financial workflows and data into experiences that feel clear and intuitive for investors, issuers and internal teams. Working closely with a senior designer, product managers and engineers, you’ll be involved in the full design process, from understanding the problem and supporting user research to prototyping, handoff and iteration after launch. This is a great fit for someone with a few years of product design experience who wants real ownership of their work, room to grow their craft, and the chance to learn a fast-moving corner of fintech along the way. ‍ **What you'll do** ------------------ * Own features and flows end-to-end, from problem framing and research support through wireframes, prototypes, handoff and post-launch iteration, with guidance from a senior designer * Turn complex workflows and financial data into clear, usable screens in Figma * Use and contribute/iterate to our existing design system so products stay consistent * Partner with PMs, engineers and QA to understand requirements and make sure designs ship as intended * Maintain regular updates and communications with team members, ensure alignment on design decisions, and refine based on feedback with cross functional teams. #### **In your first 6 months, you might** * Ship features end to end, keep the experience consistent across products, and shape the design system * Learn to work with our design libraries and system: create new components and patterns and help maintain and refine the existing ones * Turn product requirements into flows and mockups, and run design sessions with PMs and engineers * Stay involved throughout feature development and testing, balancing quality with speed. ‍ **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Around 2–3 years of product design (UI/UX) experience, in-house, agency or freelance * A strong portfolio with at least 2 case studies that show your process and what you learned, not just final screens * At least one shipped product or feature you can talk discuss in detail * Comfortable in Figma, with a working understanding of how software gets built * Confident communicating in English, written and spoken, including explaining design decisions to non-designers * Curious and open to feedback, with a genuine interest in growing your craft alongside a senior designer. * Balances outcomes for both users and the business #### **Preferred (Nice to have)** * Experience with Jira, Confluence or product analytics tools * Ability to leverage AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Figma AI) in your design workflow * A solid understanding of the SDLC and how a product is delivered as end-to-end working software * Prior experience in fintech, finance, or investment platforms is a plus ### **Company Overview** Please visit http://alta.exchange for more information
